name: Empty belly
description: You have gone too long without a meal, and the road keeps reminding you of it.
remedyNote: A day in port, a rest with provisions, or a meal on the road will clear it.
onset: By evening your hands are unsteady and the smell of bread is everywhere.
daily: Your belly is a small, patient complaint that will not be ignored.
recovery: A bowl of something plain, and the world steadies.

provenance.notes: A discrete travel condition, not a hunger meter.
